_doc: The game's sound effects, read by sfx.py. Each sound is one file, assets/sfx/<name>.ogg (or .wav); a
missing file plays nothing, so sounds can be added one at a time.
group: where it belongs (for finding it here). desc: what it should sound like and when it plays.
volume: 0-1, times the Sound setting. gap: the fewest real-time seconds between two plays of it, so
a fast game or a crowd doesn't pile it up (default 0). max: copies of it sounding at once (default 2).
core: part of the first set to make (the game feels finished with these alone).
hooked: false for the ones the game doesn't play yet (they need hooks inside entities.py or the views).
towers: the firing sound of each tower. Monster deaths are picked by size (sfx.death_sound).
seed: which soundtrack-maker seed tools/sync_sfx.py copies into assets/sfx (default 1).

shot_sniper.desc: Sharp crack with a tail: Sniper

shot_volley.desc: Scatter of several shots at once: Hailstorm, Flak Battery

shot_beam.desc: Charged beam release: Railgun, Solar Lance, Frost Lance

shot_tesla.desc: Electric zap jumping between targets: Tesla Coil

shot_blast.desc: Wide, low freezing blast: Blizzard, Absolute Zero

shot_hybrid.desc: Fire and ice together, hiss and crackle: Thermal Shock, Obsidian, Glacier Breaker

hit.desc: Small thud of a bullet landing

explosion_small.desc: Small splash explosion (splash radius up to ~60)

explosion_big.desc: Big splash explosion (Bombard, Avalanche, Absolute Zero)

freeze.desc: Ice crackle when a slow takes hold

burn.desc: Short sizzle when a burn starts

shatter.desc: Glassy crunch: bonus damage on a slowed monster

armor_ping.desc: Metallic ping: a hit mostly blocked by armor

spawn.desc: Soft whoosh out of the portal

leak.desc: Alarm hit: a monster got through and lives are lost

split.desc: Wet splat: a Splitter breaks into pieces

ward_block.desc: Shield clink: a ward swallows a hit

ward_up.desc: Quiet hum: a ward is back

phase.desc: Ghostly shimmer: a Phantom fades out or back

decoy.desc: Mirror shimmer: a Mirage casts an illusion

decoy_pop.desc: Glassy pop: an illusion is hit or fades

heal_pulse.desc: Faint chime of a Healer's aura

enrage.desc: Growl: a Berserker gets fast at low hp

rebound.desc: Quick whoosh: a Thawling sprints as a slow wears off

sabotage.desc: Electric fizzle: a Saboteur's death shorts out the towers nearby

loot.desc: Coins snatched: a Looter got through

boss_arrive.desc: Big low sting as a boss walks in

boss_summon.desc: Rumble or screech: a boss calls its minions

boss_leak.desc: Crushing hit: a boss got through, every life gone

cast_warning.desc: Rising warning tone before a recorded ability lands

ability_ready.desc: Short click: an ability's cooldown is over

fuse.desc: Two towers merge, a power-up swell

evolve.desc: Bright chime: a branch picked for a tier 3 tower

gold.desc: Tiny coin tick for kill gold (quiet, it plays a lot)

upgrade_buy.desc: Rank of Vitality, Stride or Plating bought

wave_start.desc: Horn or drum: a wave is on its way

pass_won.desc: Bigger fanfare: the pass is won, sides switch

game_over.desc: Low, falling sting: the run is over

card_pick.desc: Card flip: a reward or starter card picked

low_lives.desc: Heartbeat or alarm: lives running low
